decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page and sits close to the core natural facial care offer, the industry is growing, and nothing signals a shortfall against aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search and the firm carries it while results mature.

A hyaluronic serum is a standard, low-cost addition that fits the firm's in-house small-batch production, so with no evident performance gap the satisficing choice is to keep it, though its lower website prominence makes it somewhat more expendable.

A cleansing milk is a basic staple that rounds out the facial routine and uses existing capabilities and suppliers, so without a signal of underperformance the firm keeps it in its medium-sized range.
